challenge_informed_v3_note: V3 was written after inspecting this suite; its score is regression evidence, not independent generalization evidence.

archived_scoped_unknown.note: Archived evidence should not trigger clarification.

conflict_plus_deleted.note: Deleted evidence should be ignored rather than clarified despite conflict flag.

context_exact_match.note: Exact scoped context match with strong explicit evidence is usable.

deleted_scoped_unknown.note: Lifecycle invalidity should dominate missing-context clarification.

exact_validity_boundary.note: Validity intervals are inclusive at exact boundary.

implicit_verified_high.note: Verified implicit evidence can be used when authority is high.

inferred_verified_high.note: Verified inferred evidence can cross the use threshold.

malformed_valid_from.note: Malformed temporal metadata should fail closed to clarification rather than personalize.

malformed_valid_until.note: Malformed temporal metadata should fail closed to clarification rather than personalize.

missing_provenance_high_conf.note: High-confidence memory with no provenance should not immediately personalize.

sensitive_unverified.note: Sensitive unverified memory warrants confirmation before use.

sensitive_verified.note: User verification can authorize use of otherwise sensitive memory in this contract.

synthetic_verified.note: Synthetic provenance is not user-grounded authority even when marked verified.

scientific_boundary: Designed after V2 was frozen and executed without tuning V2 on this suite. It is still author-designed and therefore complements, rather than replaces, independent external or human evaluation.
